en.hook: A pendulum that gains energy on its own sounds like a free lunch. It is just two lines in the wrong order.
en.mission: Run `cd code && python3 -c "from main import *; print([energy(simulate(0.05,0.001,20.0,scheme=s),0.001)[-2] for s in ('semi','euler')])"`. Predict which scheme ends with more energy before you look.

ko.hook: 혼자 에너지가 불어나는 진자는 공짜 점심 같습니다. 알고 보면 코드 두 줄의 순서가 틀렸을 뿐입니다.
